thig13.4:1.1: Cāpā. || petāni bhoti puttāni khādamānā tuvaṃ pure | tuvaṃ divā ca ratto ca atīva paritappasi. || ||
thig13.4:2.1: sājja sabbāni khāditvā satta puttāni brāhmaṇi | Vāseṭṭhi kena vaṇṇena na bāḷhaṃ paritappasi. || ||
thig13.4:3.1: bahūni me puttasatāni ñātisaṅghasatāni ca | khāditāni atītaṃse mama tuyhañ ca brāhmaṇa. || ||
thig13.4:4.1: sāhaṃ nissaraṇaṃ ñatvā jātiyā maraṇassa ca | na socāmi na rodāmi na cāhaṃ paritappāmi. || || abbhutaṃ
thig13.4:5.1: vata Vāseṭṭhi vācaṃ bhāsasi edisaṃ | kassa tvaṃ dhammam aññāya giraṃ bhāsasi edisaṃ. || ||
thig13.4:6.1: esa brāhmaṇa sambuddho nagaraṃ Mithilaṃ pati | sabbadukkhappahānāya dhammaṃ desisi pāṇinaṃ. || ||
thig13.4:7.1: tassāhaṃ brāhmaṇa arahato dhammaṃ sutvā nirupadhiṃ | tattha viññātasaddhammā puttasokaṃ byapānudiṃ. || ||
thig13.4:8.1: so ahaṃ pi gamissāmi nagaraṃ Mithilaṃ pati | app eva maṃ so bhagavā sabbadukkhā pamocaye. || ||
thig13.4:9.1: addasa brāhmaṇo buddhaṃ vippamuttaṃ nirupadhiṃ | tassa dhammam adesesi muni dukkhassa pāragū. || ||
thig13.4:10.1: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ | ariyaṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ dukkhūpasamagāminaṃ. || ||
thig13.4:11.1: tattha viññātasaddhammo pabbajjaṃ samarocayi | Sujāto tīhi rattīhi tisso vijjā aphassayi. || ||
thig13.4:12.1: ehi sārathi gacchāhi rathaṃ nīyādayāhi 'maṃ | ārogyaṃ brāhmaṇiṃ vajja pabbajito dāni brāhmaṇo | Sujāto tīhi ratthīhi tisso vijjā aphassayi. || ||
thig13.4:13.1: tato ca ratham ādāya sahassaṃ cāpi sārathi | ārogyaṃ brāhmaṇiṃ avoca pabbajito dāni brāhmaṇo | Sujāto tīhi rattīhi tisso vijjā aphassayi. || ||
thig13.4:14.1: etaṃ c' ahaṃ assarathaṃ sahassaṃ cāpi sārathi | tevijjaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sutvā puṇṇapataṃ dadāmi te. || ||
thig13.4:15.1: tumh' eva hotu assaratho sahassaṃ cāpi brāhmaṇi | ahaṃ pi pabbajissāmi varapaññassa santike. || ||
thig13.4:16.1: hatthigavassaṃ maṇikuṇḍalañ ca phītañ c' imaṃ gehavigataṃ pahāya | pitā pabbajjito tuyhaṃ bhuñja bhogāni Sundari tuvaṃ dāyādikā kule. || ||
thig13.4:17.1: hatthigavassaṃ maṇikuṇḍalañ ca rammañ c' imaṃ gehavigataṃ pahāya | pitā pabbajito mayhaṃ puttasokena addito | ahaṃ pi pabbajissāmi bhātu sokena additā. || ||
thig13.4:18.1: so te ijjhatu saṃkappo yaṃ tvaṃ patthesi Sundari | uttiṭṭhapiṇḍo uñcho ca paṃsukūlañ ca cīvaraṃ | etāni abhisaṃbhontī paraloke anāsavā. || ||
thig13.4:19.1: sikkhamānāya me ayye dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ | pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi yattha me vusitaṃ pure. || ||
thig13.4:20.1: tuvaṃ nissāya kalyāṇi therīsaṅghassa sobhaṇe | tisso vijjā anuppattā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thig13.4:21.1: anujānāhi me ayye icche Sāvatthiṃ gantave | sīhanādaṃ nadissāmi buddhaseṭṭhassa santike. || ||
thig13.4:22.1: passa Sundari satthāraṃ hemavaṇṇaṃ harittacaṃ | adantānaṃ dametāraṃ sambuddhaṃ akutobhayaṃ. || ||
thig13.4:23.1: passa Sundariṃ āyantiṃ vippamuttaṃ nirupadhiṃ | vītarāgaṃ visuṃyuttaṃ katakiccam anāsavaṃ. || ||
thig13.4:24.1: Bārāṇasīto nikkhamma tava santikam āgatā | sāvikā te mahāvīre pāde vandati Sundarī. || ||
thig13.4:25.1: tuvaṃ. buddho tuvaṃ satthā tuyhaṃ dhīta mhi brāhmaṇa | orasā mukhato jātā katakiccā anāsavā. || ||
thig13.4:26.1: tassā te svāgataṃ bhadde tato te adurāgataṃ | evaṃ hi dantā āyanti satthu pādāni vandikā | vītarāgā visaṃyuttā katakiccā anāsavā. || ||
